newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Teresa Cristina railway to be sold Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Teresa Cristina railway to be sold Nov 20.

text.p: Brazil set a November 20 auction to privatize the 164-km (102-mile) Teresa Cristina branch of the federal railway network, bid specifications said Tuesday.

The document, published in local newspapers, said the government set a minimum price of 16.6 million reais for a 30-year concession to operate the rail line, linking Criciuma in the southern state of Santa Catarina with the port of Imbituba.

The winning bidder must make an initial payment of 1.662 million reais, plus the difference between the base price and the purchase price, and will have an additional 112 installments to pay the rest, the specifications said.
The document also said no individual investor may hold more than 45 percent of the company's voting stock.
The auction will be held on the floor of the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
